This plot is very small, only a quarter of a tinad, and it is rented so I do not want to put too much money into it. I will try to get a little DAP from the cooperative when they bring it — maybe half a bag if my husband and I can find the money — and I will spread the manure from our two oxen and the goats on it before plowing. I keep my own wheat seed from last harvest like my mother did; the improved seed at the cooperative is too dear for such a small plot and I am not sure it will pay back on rented land. Rain has been poor some years so I do not waste cash on chemicals I cannot be sure about; me and my daughter will do the weeding ourselves.
